page.layout: One scanned image only: a photograph of a book spine lying on a shelf, with a digitiser's copyright caption in the black band below it. No printed text block on the page.
page.notes: The scan shows the spine of a bound volume, not a printed page. Visible on the spine: a red label reading "LANSBERGII / MOTUS TERRAE" (upside down), a dark label reading "MIDDELBURGI 1630" (upside down), and a library label with "317" and "1 6" and "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE CENTRALE - FIRENZE". The digitiser's caption ("Early European Books, Copyright © 2011 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of the Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale di Firenze. CFMAGL 1.6.317") and the library stamps are excluded from the transcription. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on a page.
